title: Volunteers
body: Manage ministry membership lifecycle for your accredited church. Add volunteers as Pending or Active, activate pending members, and deactivate active members (future assignments are voided automatically).
signInRequired: Sign in to manage ministry memberships.
notAdmin: You need church admin accreditation to manage memberships here.
addHelp: Enter the volunteer profile ID (from identity or seed data).
emptyState: No memberships for this ministry yet.

errors.notAccredited: You are not accredited for this church.
